faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Indian Bank Authorised Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Indian Bank Authorised Doctor recruitment is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for the Authorised Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university in the Allopathic system of medicine and have a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Authorised Doctor position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Authorised Doctor position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the type of job for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Authorised Doctor position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. In which city and state is this recruitment taking place?
faq.answer: This recruitment is taking place in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Authorised Doctor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Authorised Doctor post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 01.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
